The 2003 Formula 1 World Drivers' Championship was won by Michael Schumacher (Ferrari), who finished with 93 points and 6 race wins. Kimi Räikkönen (McLaren) was second with 91 points, just two points behind.

ANSWER: Michael Schumacher
